artifacts.summary: Seed: the Captain's request (chat 2026-10-16): a gatekeeper judges whether a PR can merge, lets FO merge one above a bar (his example 95%), and lists what he should look at; goals: fewer FO merge accidents and less eye review. Recommended profile prod: it changes merge authority and may send PR text to an outside service. Ideation owes: the bite counted (FO merge accidents, review time per PR), a calibrated bar, the model or product (OpenAI Decisions API beta, Codex, TypeSafe Jev), an ADR draft superseding ADR 0011's never-delegated merge clause, and data sharing per repository; expect Needs decisions at its gate.
